elements.label: Figure B3.3.1
elements.title: Assessing a country’s quality infrastructure: Illustrative result using the Rapid Diagnostic Tool
elements.content:
Radar chart showing an illustrative assessment of a country's quality infrastructure using the Rapid Diagnostic Tool.
Scale: 0 to 4.0 with increments of 0.5.
Legend/Series:
- Pillar 1: Legal and institutional framework (dark blue)
- Pillar 2: Administration and infrastructure (medium blue)
- Pillar 3: Service delivery and technical competency (red/maroon)
- Pillar 4: External relations and recognition (light blue)

Axes/Categories included around the radar:
- Accreditation strategy
- Technical regulation coordination office
- Regulatory authorities
- Director
- Organizational structure
- Management and personnel
- Premises
- Equipment
- Quality system
- Developing technical regulations
- Premarket inspections
- Market surveillance
- Sanctions
- Training system
- Information system
- Liaison with regional organizations
- Liaison with international organizations

Source: Kellermann 2019a.
Source: WDR 2025 team.
a. Refer to Guasch et al. (2007); Kellermann (2019a); Racine (2011).
